title: Steerable CNN irrep-channel Mirror specialization
amendment: 02: amendment 01 stopped before any matched comparison because in-place irrep code assembly broke autograd; fix uses functional concatenation
scope: CPU synthetic mechanism screen using official e2cnn; no natural image or broad steerable-CNN claim.
hypothesis: A compact task×irrep code over a shared C4-steerable CNN can specialize group-related tasks with lower full serialized bytes than independent task heads; an ordinary per-channel gate is the strongest low-cost control, and a non-orbit task may require private state.
physical_object: One e2cnn C4 steerable convolutional trunk with regular-representation hidden fields and output multiplicities of real irreps 0, 1, and 2.
mirror_coordinate: Three learned per-task scalars multiply shared readout weights for each irrep block; private exception adds one task-specific readout.
logical_multiplicity: Two orientation tasks in the same C4 orbit plus an object-class task outside the orbit; orbit copies do not count as independent capacity.
controls: shared readout with learned task×irrep scalars
same shared readout with task×channel ordinary gate
Mirror code plus private task-2 readout

development.selection_metric: shape/import smoke only; no hyperparameter selection

success_gate: Mirror reaches at least 95% of independent-head accuracy on both orbit tasks on every fresh seed, full payload is at most 90% of independent heads, and ordinary per-channel gate does not match at equal/fewer bytes.
failure_gate: Any quality or byte gate miss, or ordinary gate matching Mirror at no greater byte cost.
boundaries: Exact C4 task copies are not extra independent functions.
Learned irrep scalars may be ordinary irrep gating; any such alias precludes Mirror-specific attribution.
No natural-image, broad equivariance, or capacity claim.
implementation_history: Amendment 01 implementation run aborted after the first native-head row due to an autograd in-place mutation in the Mirror branch; no matched comparison was produced. That exposed seed is excluded from amendment 02.
Amendment 02 uses three new seeds, fixed before re-running any condition.
